notes: Sandbox Node v22.23.5 was too old for bootstrap; Node v24.22.3 was installed from nodejs.org (checksum verified). Bootstrap npm+submodule+reference took 3m18s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry test took 59s.
Tables are built under both expression profiles and must agree, because geometry() has no run profile; this is stricter than using the run's profile and is documented in docs/contributing/lut.md.
Expression syntax is checked per component present in the negotiated format (in geometry), as native config_props parses only those; gammaval/unported refusals are made in parse for all components.

Legacy yuvj links reach the operator as yuv storage with metadata colorRange 2; the kernel maps that to the yuvj format to use config_props' full-range default case. Matched native on all three yuvj negotiation sources.
No case is linux-gated; no macOS run was made in this sandbox.
